displayIdentity.body: Paul remembers violence, mercy, and a trustworthy saying. I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service, Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
